name: langgraph
description: Stateful, multi-actor agent orchestration framework with cycles, persistence, and human-in-the-loop control.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Mutating graph state in-place inside node functions instead of returning partial state updates
Creating cyclic edges without a conditional termination branch to END, causing infinite recursion errors
Omitting thread_id inside configurable options when invoking a graph compiled with a checkpointer
checklist: State schema defined via Annotation.Root (TS) or TypedDict with Annotated reducers (Python)
Conditional edges explicitly map terminal conditions to END
Checkpointer (MemorySaver or PostgresSaver) configured with thread_id for multi-turn memory
